articles.summary: PEMBROKE, BERMUDA, July 17, 2025 — Hamilton Insurance Group, Ltd. (NYSE: HG) (“Hamilton” or the “Company”) today announced the appointment of Raymond Karrenbauer as Group Chief Information Officer, effective September 15, 2025.
